heroSectionData.subheading1: Software bots for an automated workplace
heroSectionData.para1: RPA, aimed at automating business processes, uses tools, or a “robot,” to capture and interpret applications for processing a transaction, manipulating data, triggering responses and communicating with other digital systems.

Projectflow.heading1: Access a range of automation services

Cards.heading: RPA consulting
Cards.content: By identifying blockers, opportunities, and calculating automation potential, we create a detailed roadmap to strategic RPA adoption.

Cards.heading: Automation design
Cards.content: We define intervention models to apply to your workflows and design an automation architecture to clarify your RPS solution, even with a PoC, to assure value.

Cards.heading: RPA development
Cards.content: Using UIpath, Microsoft Power Automate and other RPA tools, we create intelligent applications based on the defined automation pipeline.

Cards.heading: Infrastructure support
Cards.content: We ensure that your software bots are performing at the highest level of productivity and also help you find new automation opportunities.

Cards.heading: Managed RPA services
Cards.content: We take over your RPA support and maintenance tasks so that your tech teams can focus on innovation and a strategic RPA scale-up.

Cards.heading: Automation support
Cards.content: Our experts offer all-round support throughout the process of automating your internal workflows.

Cards.heading: RPA center of excellence
Cards.content: Our CoE embeds and implements RPA deeply and effectively into the organization.

darkAndLightComponentCards.title: Cost saving
darkAndLightComponentCards.description: Automation in manual tasks enables notable cuts in costs and also significantly lowers employee FTEs.

darkAndLightComponentCards.title: In-depth analysis
darkAndLightComponentCards.description: Intricately designed workflows are operated by automation bots with detailed logs available at every step of the operation.

darkAndLightComponentCards.title: Task automation
darkAndLightComponentCards.description: A generalized and specialized automation of workplace tasks helps improve functionality, efficiency, and reduces error potential.

darkAndLightComponentCards.title: Assured accuracy
darkAndLightComponentCards.description: Once trained, robots function at their full operating potential while eliminating any human error and performing repetitive tasks with extreme accuracy.

MediaSection.title: Building smart robots to instill automation
MediaSection.description: We recognise your business goals for the future and develop a sustainable automation plan which keeps your business objectives in focus to ensure that the automation doesn’t clash with the growth, but rather speeds it up.
